mainEntity.name: Should I focus on multiple cities at once or one city at a time for GEO content?

acceptedAnswer.text: For businesses with limited resources, focusing on one primary city or a few key target areas at a time is often more effective. This allows for deeper content customization, better local SEO optimization, and a stronger local presence before expanding. Attempting to target too many locations simultaneously can dilute efforts and lead to less impactful results for each area. Prioritizing based on market opportunity and business goals can lead to more sustainable growth and better ROI.
acceptedAnswer.description: For limited resources, focus on one city or a few key target areas at a time for deeper customization and stronger local presence. Spreading efforts too thin can dilute results.
